Learner notes for **[COURSE-CODE] ([Course Name])**. Each lecture week is a chapter under `lectures/`. Preview with `quarto preview` from this directory, or open `_site/index.html` after `quarto render`.

Fill the `[BRACKETED]` placeholders here and in `COURSE.md` after `/course-notes init`. Do not add week chapters by hand; `/course-notes add` inserts `lectures/weekNN.qmd` into `_quarto.yml` before the glossary.
